Misconfigurations.Title: Access to host network
Misconfigurations.Description: Sharing the host’s network namespace permits processes in the pod to communicate with processes bound to the host’s loopback adapter.
Misconfigurations.Message: DaemonSet 'node-exporter' should not set 'spec.template.spec.hostNetwork' to true

Misconfigurations.Title: Access to host PID
Misconfigurations.Description: Sharing the host’s PID namespace allows visibility on host processes, potentially leaking information such as environment variables and configuration.
Misconfigurations.Message: DaemonSet 'node-exporter' should not set 'spec.template.spec.hostPID' to true

Misconfigurations.Title: Runs with GID <= 10000
Misconfigurations.Description: Force the container to run with group ID > 10000 to avoid conflicts with the host’s user table.

Misconfigurations.Title: hostPath volumes mounted
Misconfigurations.Description: According to pod security standard 'HostPath Volumes', HostPath volumes must be forbidden.

Misconfigurations.Title: Runtime/Default Seccomp profile not set
Misconfigurations.Description: According to pod security standard 'Seccomp', the RuntimeDefault seccomp profile must be required, or allow specific additional profiles.
Misconfigurations.Message: Either Pod or Container should set 'securityContext.seccompProfile.type' to 'RuntimeDefault'

Misconfigurations.Title: All container images must start with the *.azurecr.io domain
Misconfigurations.Description: Containers should only use images from trusted registries.
Misconfigurations.Message: container node-exporter of daemonset node-exporter in monitoring namespace should restrict container image to your specific registry domain. For Azure any domain ending in 'azurecr.io'
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use images from trusted Azure registries.

Misconfigurations.Title: All container images must start with a GCR domain
Misconfigurations.Description: Containers should only use images from trusted GCR registries.
Misconfigurations.Message: container node-exporter of daemonset node-exporter in monitoring namespace should restrict container image to your specific registry domain. See the full GCR list here: https://cloud.google.com/container-registry/docs/overview#registries
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use images from trusted GCR registries.

Misconfigurations.Title: Container images from public registries used
Misconfigurations.Description: Container images must not start with an empty prefix or a defined public registry domain.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'node-exporter' of DaemonSet 'node-exporter' should restrict container image to use private registries

Misconfigurations.Title: All container images must start with an ECR domain
Misconfigurations.Description: Container images from non-ECR registries should be forbidden.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'node-exporter' of DaemonSet 'node-exporter' should restrict images to own ECR repository. See the full ECR list here: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/ecr.html
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Container image should be used from Amazon container Registry

Misconfigurations.Title: Do not allow privilege escalation from node proxy
Misconfigurations.Description: Check whether role permits privilege escalation from node proxy
Misconfigurations.Message: Role permits privilege escalation from node proxy
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Create a role which does not permit privilege escalation from node proxy

Misconfigurations.Title: Seccomp policies disabled
Misconfigurations.Description: A program inside the container can bypass Seccomp protection policies.
Misconfigurations.Message: container "node-exporter" of daemonset "node-exporter" in "monitoring" namespace should specify a seccomp profile
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Specify seccomp either by annotation or by seccomp profile type having allowed values as per pod security standards

Misconfigurations.Title: Kubernetes resource with disallowed volumes mounted
Misconfigurations.Description: HostPath present many security risks and as a security practice it is better to avoid critical host paths mounts.
Misconfigurations.Message: daemonset node-exporter in monitoring namespace shouldn't have volumes set to {"/proc", "/sys"}
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Do not Set 'spec.volumes[*].hostPath.path' to any of the disallowed volumes.

Misconfigurations.Title: Restrict container images to trusted registries
Misconfigurations.Description: Ensure that all containers use images only from trusted registry domains.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container node-exporter in daemonset node-exporter (namespace: monitoring) uses an image from an untrusted registry.
